inwinding.m: The -ing form of inwind. inwind: to wind inward.

inwinds.m: A form of inwind, as in “she inwinds”. inwind: to wind inward.

inwrap.m: Another spelling of enwrap. enwrap: enclose or enfold completely with or as if with a covering.

inwrapping.m: Another spelling of enwrapping. enwrapping: enclose or enfold completely with or as if with a covering.
